intro.heading: Your Rotation Experience
intro.body: Thank you for completing your ASPIRE clinical rotation. This short survey asks about your learning experience and the support you received. It is used to improve the ASPIRE learning environment. This is NOT a personnel performance review of your preceptor.
intro.compliance_note: Your feedback helps ASPIRE strengthen the learning environment for future students. Please answer honestly based on your own experience.

evaluatedTarget.title: Preceptor / Unit
evaluatedTarget.instructions: These details are pre-filled from your ASPIRE record. They identify the rotation this feedback is about.

section1.title: Preceptor Support
section1.instructions: Please rate the following statements about your preceptor's support of your learning.

items.approachable_available: My preceptor was approachable and available when I needed guidance.
items.clear_explanations: My preceptor provided clear explanations and expectations.
items.useful_feedback: My preceptor gave useful and timely feedback.
items.skill_development: My preceptor supported my skill development and growing independence.

section2.title: Learning Environment
section2.instructions: Please rate the following statements about the unit as a learning environment.

items.included_in_care: I was meaningfully included in patient care activities.
items.welcoming_unit: The unit was welcoming and supportive of students.
items.practice_opportunities: I had appropriate opportunities to practice and learn.
items.workflow_supported_learning: The unit workflow and assignments supported my learning.

section3.title: Psychological Safety
section3.instructions: Please rate the following statements about how comfortable you felt during the rotation.

items.comfortable_speaking_up: I felt comfortable speaking up when I was unsure.
items.comfortable_raising_concerns: I felt comfortable raising concerns about patient care or safety.

section4.title: Overall Experience
section4.instructions: A few overall questions about your rotation.

items.valuable_experience: Overall, this rotation was a valuable learning experience.
items.would_recommend: I would recommend this unit as a learning environment for future ASPIRE students.

overall_rating.label: Overall rating of the rotation experience

strengths.label: What worked well about your preceptor/unit experience?

suggestions.label: What could improve the experience for future students?

attestation.label: I confirm this feedback reflects my genuine experience and is intended to help improve the ASPIRE learning environment.
